title: Astrophysics for People in a Hurry

questions.q: Who wrote Astrophysics for People in a Hurry?
What fraction of the universe's mass is galaxies and gas clouds?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says only one-sixth of mass is galaxies and gas clouds.
Lesson 2 says it was found in the Sun's spectrum first.

questions.q: What does helium's discovery suggest about the universe?
a: Celestial matter follows laws like ours
questions.why: Lesson 2 says it shows similar laws.

questions.q: How did the universe start, per lesson 3?
a: As a tiny, extremely hot dot that expanded and cooled
